valuation.method: EV / Forward Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA (FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA viewed at the 12-month target date), less projected net debt and non-controlling interests (CQP), divided by projected diluted common shares

bear.driver: Spot LNG margin compression offsets Corpus Christi Stage 3 volume ramp
bear.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA $8.60B at 9.5x EV/EBITDA ($81.70B EV), less $25.0B net debt and NCI, / 200M shares

base.driver: Full-year Corpus Christi Stage 3 contribution (~57 mtpa production) with normalized spot margins
base.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA $9.60B at 10.0x EV/EBITDA ($96.00B EV), less $25.0B net debt and NCI, / 198M shares

bull.driver: 58 mtpa production with tight global LNG supply and strong spot optimization
bull.assumption: FY2027E Adjusted EBITDA $10.40B at 10.5x EV/EBITDA ($109.20B EV), less $24.5B net debt and NCI, / 195M shares

valuation.implied_by_close: At $9.60B FY2027E base Adjusted EBITDA, ~$25.0B net debt/NCI, and ~204M current shares, the $308.75 close implies 9.2x EV/EBITDA; the analyst target range ($327-$377) implies ~9.5x-10.6x.
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of EV/EBITDA on $9.60B base EBITDA moves the base target by $48.48 (+15.7 pp at $308.75).
valuation.watch_metric: Official FY2027 Consolidated Adjusted EBITDA guidance and LNG production volume (56-58 mtpa target)

analyst_notes: Following Cheniere's Q3 2026 beat-and-raise on Oct 29, 2026 (FY2026 Adjusted EBITDA guidance raised to $8.75B-$9.25B), five of the six tracked analysts raised targets between Oct 30 and Nov 3, 2026, while JPMorgan raised ahead of earnings on Oct 23. All six maintain Buy-equivalent ratings with targets spanning $327-$377, clustering around our $358.60 base case; horizon_months is null because broker 12-month target disclosures were not verified in the secondary summaries.
